profile.headline: Software Engineer II, UI/UX @ Microsoft | Building the next generation of iconic Windows apps
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer specializing in game/SDK development (Unity, C#) and cross-platform applications (Web, Mobile, AR/XR). Experienced in leading projects and fostering strong collaboration with internal teams and external partners globally. Passionate about building impactful, engaging experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Building the next iconic Windows app. Focused on the intersection of high-performance graphics and intuitive UX for 1B+ users.

Directly responsible for the end-to-end UI/UX and feature implementation of a new, first-party Windows application. Working within the team behind iconic utilities like Snipping Tool and Paint, focusing on building a high-performance, creative experience for millions of Windows users.

Core Impact

Greenfield Development: Architecting and implementing core user-facing features for a brand-new Windows experience, prioritizing scalability and the Fluent Design System.

High-Performance Graphics: Leveraging Win2D and immediate-mode rendering to build fluid, hardware-accelerated creative tools that maintain excellent performance.

Product Engineering: Partnering with the Windows Design Team to bridge the gap between high-fidelity mocks and production code, ensuring a polished "pixel-perfect" feel across varied form factors.

Modern Windows Stack: Utilizing the latest Windows App SDK and WinUI 3 to define the standard for what a modern, native Windows application should look and feel like.

Technical Focus

UI/UX: Advanced XAML/C# development, custom control templating, and complex layout management.

Graphics: 2D rendering pipelines, image processing, and canvas-based interactions.

Architecture: Implementation of robust MVVM patterns to ensure maintainability in a high-scale environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Deeply understanding the Niantic Platform API and their underlying implementations. Acting as the “first line” consumer of Niantic SDKs, writing effective applications that demonstrate the use of our API and Platform to our integrators.

Collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and business development, to gather requirements, provide technical expertise, and ensure project success.

Developing and delivering technical presentations and demos to internal and external stakeholders, communicating project concepts, progress, and results.

Gathering technical requirements, giving presentations/demos, performing design review, receiving feedback, and working with Engineering, Developer Relations, Business Development, and Product teams to ensure partnerships are successful.

Acting as a subject matter expert in relevant project/product and technology areas.

Proposing and implementing critical initiatives to improve the integration processes, which requires working with cross-functional teams.

Built strong relationships with international partners, collaborating on projects and demonstrating a deep understanding of cultural sensitivity and international business practices.

Drove the adoption of Niantic's Lightship ARDK, providing technical guidance and support to external partners, resulting in the successful onboarding of key enterprise clients.

Designed, developed, and tested interactive, multi-user AR/MR experiences for mobile and Magic Leap 2, focusing on intuitive user interactions and seamless collaboration.

Co-led the development and launch of the Lightship Maps SDK for Unity, empowering developers to create location-based AR experiences using Niantic's platform.

positions.title: Technical Game Designer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented new interfaces and workflows for Shadow Health's Digital Clinical Experiences (DCEs), including those for Differential Diagnosing, Virtual Patient Communication, and Nursing Care Plan development, using data-driven design and practices.

Founded Design@ShadowHealth, an internal cross-disciplinary design team focused on developing and maintaining design standards and best practices and promoting UX and Design Thinking.

Worked with a cross-disciplinary team of instructional designers, software developers, content developers, artists and nursing experts to create educational simulation software that trains nurses and healthcare students.

Collaborated with Subject Matter Experts, market stakeholders, and end users to procure feedback and improve designs.

Contributed to Shadow Health’s success by creating and improving the interactive online environment that allows students to grow and learn
positions.insights: Skills: Unity3D · Game Development · Simulation · Interaction Design · Game Design

positions.title: Design Consultant / Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Provided design and architecture consultation on virtual reality training simulation prototypes.

Participated in the design of information and operational support systems.

Managed back-end and systems for marketing and app site deployments.

Installed, configured, tested and maintained operating systems, application software and system management tools.

Proactively ensured the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability.

Monitored and tested application performance for potential bottlenecks, identified possible solutions, and worked with developers to implement those fixes.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Unity3D · Virtual Reality (VR)

positions.title: Web Developer (Remote)
positions.description:
Designed and developed custom web templates using JavaScript, PHP, and Twig, in addition to Joomla internal tools and plugins.

Implemented API wrapper to Riot Games for League of Legends game data visualization, increasing site traffic by displaying player stats.

Collaborated remotely with web development and other internal teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · PHP · Joomla · Twig (Template Engine)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Lead Backoffice Developer

Developed user-friendly backoffice for point-of-sale system administration using AngularJS and Laravel.

Created custom directives for form validation, batch database processes, and user permissions, ensuring secure transactions between database and client.

Implemented inventory and recipe system, streamlining menu item creation for administrators.

Performed continuous integration of production builds to ensure constant increases in site performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Web Development · AngularJS · Laravel

projects.title: Pacific Armada
projects.description:
Roles: 

Lead Designer, Lead Programmer


Concept:

In the early 17th century, the mysterious and vast Pacific Ocean has been a key travel route for sailors and pirates alike. A Malaysian pirate fleet, the Black Powder Bandits, has decided to embark on a journey to claim their rightful spoils of the Pacific Gold Rush. The pirate fleet begins at the pier of the Strait of Malacca. Their Captain was pleased to announce the terminus of their adventure would be the exotic New World – the United States. Burdened by the pressure of limited time and an exhausting food supply, the Bandits need to trek across half the globe, making their way through seven exotic countries. Avoiding water-borne dangers and cannon fire is just the beginning; can the Bandits get the gold before their time runs out?

Unity Web Player version available here.

Note: You may need to install Unity Web Player. Unity Web Player no longer works on the Google Chrome browser.

Pacific Armada was created in May 2015 as part of Game Design Practices 1 (DIG 3713C) at the University of Florida.

organizations.name: Interaction Design Foundation
organizations.description:
The Interaction Design Foundation is the biggest online design school globally.

They are a market leader in online design education--their content is created by the world's leading experts speacializing in design. Their courses cover the entire spectrum of UX design from beginner to advanced.

organizations.name: BADAS Society
organizations.description: The Bachelors of Arts in Digital Arts and Sciences Society (BADAS Society) is a Student Organization at the University of Florida whose purpose is to engage the community in innovations in technology, create awareness about the Bachelors of Arts in Digital Arts and Sciences program, and to share in the experience of learning.
